events.argText: ◈ CRISIS — THE BREACH. It got INSIDE. The haven was supposed to be the safe place — the one place. It isn’t.
SYSTEM: "Perimeter violated! This is unprecedented! ...Is this unprecedented? Checking. Yes. Unprecedented."
A crow on the treeline. Watching. It has been watching for some time — and it has not blinked.
(It strafes a straight lane — the SHADOW is the warning. Step OFF the lane, not along it. It always lands after a run.)
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
You don't know what that was. A crow that watches too long and blinks too little. Someone at the haven should hear about this.
⚔ NEVERMORE! Hans joins you!
Turn-based now. Tap a tile to move — speed is squares. Then act.
Giovanni plants their feet. "Finally. A fight worth watching."
COMBAT! NEVERMORE! The gamblers lean in. ROUND 1 — FIGHT!
It comes apart — no one in reach, no one chasing. The fight ends; they melt back into the wilds.
It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.
It RAN! Style score: 0. The gamblers wanted blood, but they'll settle for drama.
🐗 This one came with the raid on Haven — it was with the teeth at the door, not a lone wanderer.
